title: Total effort includes review and rework
method: Synthetic equal-scope workload. Baseline = 30 implementation + 8 review + 4 rework hours. Assisted = 22 + 12 + 5. Relative reduction = (42 − 39)/42 = 7.14%. Excludes later maintenance and makes no causal or staffing claim.
alt: Total effort includes review and rework. Baseline total: 42 person-hours for ten changes, Assisted total: 39 person-hours for ten changes. Illustrative data.
